revision: round 4b: the cutaway ROAMA tower. One continuous camera path 0..1: the whole tower, then per floor (~0.137 of the scroll) rise outside the cut face -> dolly into the room -> slow push-in on the agent (hold) -> pull out and rise. The top floor is the Owner's office (no human): the camera ends behind the empty chair looking out of the panoramic window at the night city.
notes: progress = the page scroll of the pinned <scene-3d> section, 0..1 (the player's progress; the keys in scene-3d.json are placed through the player's smoothstep ease, these values are page-scroll). range = the scroll that belongs to the floor (from the middle of the flight before to the middle of the flight after). hold = the camera is inside the room and slowly pushes in on the agent: show the caption fully there, fade it in during [range[0], hold[0]]. node = the agent's GLB node (an empty at chest height); stop_node = an empty over the agent's head; lamp_node = the room's amber lamp (glow). caption_anchor = [x, y] on screen, 0..1 from the top left, where the caption box starts. anchor_world = the point over the agent's head in the scene's Z-up coordinates (the same frame as the scroll keys), for a site that projects its own anchor.

phone.note: round 4b fix 2 (QA): the player keeps the horizontal angle on portrait screens, so the desktop path showed two or three floors stacked small at 390 px and 768x1024. The portrait path (scene-3d.phone.json) has the same model and the same scroll stops ('at' values unchanged, so the ranges, holds and captions above apply as they are) with cameras that stay in front of the cut face and frame one room on its agent. The 42 frames are captured from that path at 720x1280. Checked at 390x844 and 768x1024.
phone.script: tour-phone.js: load it as a module BEFORE scene-3d/scene-3d.js. Phones (<=767 px): the element is replaced before the 3D loads by a sticky canvas of the same scroll length scrubbing the frames (no GLB download); children with data-at rise at the same progress. Portrait tablets (768-1024 px): the element is pointed at scene-3d.phone.json. Reduced motion / Save-Data: the poster still.
